How to Buy and Sell BNB Coin on Binance (Tutorial for Beginners)

Buying and selling BNB Coin on Binance is a simple process that only takes a few minutes.

https://accounts.binance.com/register?ref=JL3MPH7U

Using a referral code may provide trading fee discounts and promotional bonuses depending on current Binance campaigns.

What is BNB Coin?

BNB (Binance Coin) is the native cryptocurrency of the Binance ecosystem. It is used to pay trading fees, participate in token launches, and access many services within the Binance platform.

BNB was originally launched on Ethereum but later migrated to BNB Chain, Binance’s own blockchain network.

Benefits of Holding BNB

Holding BNB on Binance can provide several advantages:

• Discount on trading fees when paying with BNB
• Access to Binance Launchpad and Launchpool token sales
• Participation in new crypto projects
• Utility across BNB Chain ecosystem applications
• Possible rewards from staking and promotions

Because of these utilities, many traders keep a portion of their portfolio in BNB Coin.

Step 1 — Create a Binance Account

To start trading BNB, first create a Binance account.

Go to Binance registration page
Enter your email or phone number
Create a secure password
Enter the referral code JL3MPH7U

Once registered, you can log into your account and begin the verification process.

Step 2 — Complete Binance KYC Verification

Binance requires KYC (Know Your Customer) verification to unlock full trading features.

Steps:

Go to Identification / Verification
Upload a valid government ID
Complete facial verification
Wait for approval (usually a few minutes)

After KYC approval, you can deposit funds and start trading.

Step 3 — Enable 2FA Security

For better account protection, enable Two-Factor Authentication (2FA).

Recommended options:

• Google Authenticator
• Binance Authenticator
• SMS verification

2FA helps protect your account from unauthorized access and is strongly recommended before depositing funds.

Step 4 — Make Your First Deposit

After verification, you need to deposit funds.

Methods include:

• Crypto deposit from another wallet
• Bank transfer (depending on region)
• Credit or debit card purchase

Once the deposit arrives in your Spot Wallet, you can start trading BNB.

Step 5 — Buy BNB Coin on Binance

To buy BNB:

Go to Trade → Spot
Search for BNB/USDT or another BNB pair
Choose Market Order for instant purchase
Enter the amount
Click Buy BNB

Your BNB will appear instantly in your wallet.

You can convert BNB back into USDT, BTC, or other cryptocurrencies.

This video and guide are for educational purposes only and not financial advice.

visual_context_notes.observation: The opening frame presents the material as "HOW TO BUY AND SELL BNB COIN ON BINANCE FOR BEGINNERS" and identifies the presenter as a Binance affiliate; later frames show Binance-branded account, purchase, and trading interfaces.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a step-by-step educational demonstration of creating a Binance account, funding it, and using the BNB spot-trading interface. The referral code and benefit claims are disclosed as an affiliate promotion, while the cryptocurrency risk warning and statement that it is not investment advice make the apparent promotional cues insufficient to establish deception.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is an operational walkthrough of account setup and BNB spot trading; the speaker also promotes a referral code and claims associated benefits.
